text: An article about endangered species. Look at this picture of a rhino.
They are in danger of extinction, right?
Yes. People hunt them for their horns. It's illegal, but it still happens.
That's terrible. What can we do to protect them?
We need to stop the illegal trade of animal parts. We should also protect their natural habitats.
My school is organising an environmental project next week. We're going to plant trees in the national park.
That's a great idea! Planting trees helps provide a habitat for animals and reduces air pollution.
